components: an inner curl opening into the broad left loop
strokeOrder: start inside the curl and sweep around the broad left loop
without lifting, climb the outer left side into the crown
without lifting, carry the top bar to the right
without lifting, retrace left to the right upright and draw it down
without lifting, continue down-left along the diagonal foot
without lifting, turn at the foot and finish back up-right
strokeOrderNote: one continuous stroke — six joined movements from the inner curl through the hooked diagonal foot; cited to Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Module 7 and Appendix I Frame 7, ஏ

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sankaran Radhakrishnan, Tamil Script Learners Manual, Module 7, ஏ, with Appendix I: Hand-movements, Frame 7 (University of Texas at Austin), p. 193
strokeOrderSource.variation: Module 7 identifies ஏ as long e. Appendix I Frame 7 numbers six visibly connected movements: curl, outer loop, top bar, descending upright, and the down-and-back diagonal foot. This continuous learner order is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Tamil outline; Tamil handwriting varies by school.

notes: Independent long ē appears in ஏன் (ēṉ, why) and ஏனென்றால் (ēṉeṉṟāl, because). The Frame 7 path stays on the page for all six movements, so learners can practise the whole letter slowly before using it in those words.
